subject: [PATCH v6 08/19] selftests/mm: add folio-order check for address ranges

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function called is_range_backed_by_order() to the selftests/mm module. This function checks if a given address range is backed by folios of a specific order, ensuring that each part of the range maps one folio of that order from head to tail. The function is designed to be used in mTHP collapse tests and requires every folio-sized, folio-aligned part of the range to map one folio of the target order. If any part of the range fails this condition, the function returns false.
